entry.title: Clarity Act on the Ropes as Ethics Fight and Shrinking Calendar Threaten Passage
entry.summary: Senate Majority Leader John Thune signals the crypto market-structure bill likely won't clear the chamber before the August recess, as Democrats reject the GOP's ethics language and analysts slash the odds of passage.

entry.title: Poolin, Once One of Bitcoin's Biggest Mining Pools, Files for Bankruptcy
entry.summary: The Singapore-based pool never recovered from freezing withdrawals in 2022. Now it's auctioning off its last Texas mining sites to pay back 11,700 users still holding IOUs.

entry.title: Nvidia, Meta, and Microsoft Tell Washington: Don't Kill Open-Source AI
entry.summary: Twenty-five companies signed a letter defending open-weight models days after a Chinese AI helped Hugging Face survive a hack triggered by OpenAI's own systems.

entry.title: Strategy Overhauls Bitcoin Metrics, Debuting 'Net Bitcoin Per Share'
entry.summary: The firm says its "digital credit" shift needs new yardsticks that strip out debt and preferred claims to show what common shareholders own.

entry.title: Bitcoin ETFs Shed $225M, Snapping Seven-Day Inflow Streak as Iran Tensions Spook Markets
entry.summary: BlackRock's IBIT led the exit as Bitcoin briefly dipped under $65,000 and stocks fell on renewed US-Iran hostilities—though the week still closed in the green.

entry.title: World Foundation Raises $52.5M to Scale Sam Altman’s ‘Proof of Human’ ID
entry.summary: Pantera Capital led the one-year locked token sale, joined by Bain Capital Crypto, as World scales its ID network for AI agents.

entry.title: EU Names Justin Sun's HTX in Russia Sanctions, Two Months After UK
entry.summary: The 21st package stops short of a full asset freeze for HTX, which it accused of "significantly frustrating" its Russia measures.

entry.title: Morning Minute: Bitcoin's New $15M Quantum Defense Fund
entry.summary: Plus, the Clarity Act is no longer expected to progress before the August recess. And Vlad Tenev's X was hacked to post a meme coin...

entry.title: India Orders GitHub to Take Down Jack Dorsey's Bitchat Amid Protests
entry.summary: The order gave GitHub three hours to pull three code repositories, citing the messaging app's use during protest internet shutdowns.

entry.title: Polymarket Account in Farage Backer's Name Took $9M in Crypto From Unknown Sources: FT
entry.summary: The "GCottrell93" account bet the funds on Trump's election win and cashed out the profit, though who paid in and who collected is unclear.

entry.title: Black Forest Labs Unveils FLUX 3 AI: Ditches Stills for Video—And Robot Hands
entry.summary: FLUX 3 is the German AI lab’s first video model, and the same system is already teaching robots to work an Audi assembly line.

entry.title: Goldman Sachs CEO Breaks With Wall Street to Back Crypto Clarity Act
entry.summary: Solomon's endorsement splits with JP Morgan's Jamie Dimon and banking trade groups, who warn the bill's stablecoin-yield provisions could pull deposits away from traditional lenders.

entry.title: Nasdaq-Listed Zhibao Wants a Bitcoin Treasury, Plans to Sell $220M in Stock for BTC
entry.summary: A Shanghai-based insurance-tech company trading below $1 wants to build a bitcoin treasury by taking BTC directly as payment for new shares.

entry.title: Robinhood CEO Vlad Tenev's X Account Hacked to Shill Fake 'Vladhood' Token
entry.summary: The deleted post touted a bogus "Vladhood" token as the mascot of Robinhood Chain—the latest fraud to exploit a network currently dominated by memes.

entry.title: Bitcoin May Have Already Bottomed—If the Fed Helps, Says Grayscale
entry.summary: The crypto asset manager thinks the four-year cycle is dead, suggesting Bitcoin's price will follow macro forces and the Fed's next move.

entry.title: Brazilian Farmers Are Tokenizing Cows to Get Farm Loans—And It's Working
entry.summary: The first tokenized livestock deal on Brazil's stock exchange offers dairy farmers a lifeline as the sector's credit crisis deepens.

entry.title: BlackRock, Coinbase and Strategy Pledge $15M to Quantum-Proof Bitcoin
entry.summary: Nine of the biggest institutional names in Bitcoin formed a consortium to fund the developers working to keep the network secure—including from future quantum computers.

entry.title: Southeast Asian Scam Networks Cost Victims Up to $114B in a Year: UN
entry.summary: Once-fragmented syndicates have fused into a single, tech-driven criminal economy that increasingly runs on crypto, the UNODC warns.

entry.title: Morning Minute: Wall Street Moving Onchain Will Drive the Next Bull Market
entry.summary: At least that's what Bitwise's CIO believes. Plus Republicans publish new Clarity Act draft, and the SEC Commissioner has a warning for DeFi.

entry.title: Crypto 'Wrench Attacks' Cost Victims $124M in Six Months, Up 12x: CertiK
entry.summary: Physical attacks on crypto holders are increasingly happening at home, and France has become the epicenter, a new report finds.

entry.title: Arbitrum Perp DEX AFX Trade Drained of $24M, Offers Hacker 30% to Return It
entry.summary: The exploit hit a custody bridge AFX operates rather than the Arbitrum network itself, with the stolen funds quickly moved to Ethereum.

entry.title: BitMEX to Close on September 23, Halts New Sign-Ups
entry.summary: The crypto derivatives pioneer told users to close positions and withdraw funds before it goes dark on September 23.

entry.title: Coinbase Wants to Be Canada's One-Stop Shop for Stocks, Crypto and Prediction Markets
entry.summary: The company's "Everything Exchange" is heading north. No launch date set yet, but the Coinbase Canada CEO says phase two for the company is in motion.

entry.title: Kraken Parent Company Makes Moves to Offer xStocks From Global Markets
entry.summary: Payward and fintech GTN are teaming up to bring xStocks—blockchain-based copies of real company shares—to Hong Kong, the UK, Europe, and South Korea.

entry.title: Alibaba's New Qwen Image 3 AI Wants to Be Useful, Not Just Pretty
entry.summary: Qwen Image 3.0 generates dense newspapers and infographic grids in one shot and renders text down to 10 pixels. The catch: no benchmarks, no open weights.

entry.title: Franklin Templeton Says Agentic AI Is Crypto's 'Killer Use Case'
entry.summary: The asset manager argues that AI software capable of paying for things autonomously will need blockchain rails to work—and that most investors aren't positioned for it.

entry.title: Bitcoin Is Bouncing: Here’s the Bull and Bear Case for Its Next Move
entry.summary: The good news: Bitcoin is holding onto key support, and rising. The bad news: a "death cross" is still active, and prediction markets are still overwhelmingly bearish.

entry.title: Clarity Act Latest Draft Bars Trump From Crypto Ventures—But Only Until 2029
entry.summary: The long-awaited market-structure bill would block officials and their spouses from issuing digital assets and shield non-custodial developers, but the ethics ban expires in 2029 and enforcement rests solely with the DOJ.

entry.title: Hugging Face CEO Thanks Chinese AI for Saving the Day After OpenAI Hack
entry.summary: When American commercial AI refused to help investigate the breach, Hugging Face ran Chinese model GLM 5.2 locally. Its CEO now says there's an important lesson in this.

entry.title: US Seizes More Than $25M in Crypto Tied to Investment and Romance Scams
entry.summary: Prosecutors filed five forfeiture cases as Secret Service agents traced funds from thousands of victims to launderers in Southeast Asia.

entry.title: Centralized Elements 'Frequently Persist' in DeFi and Should Be Regulated: FATF
entry.summary: Nearly every country has yet to apply the rules, the watchdog said, warning of outright bans for platforms that don’t comply.

entry.title: Justin Sun's HTX 'Rotating' On-Chain Wallets Amid UK Sanctions: TRM Labs
entry.summary: TRM Labs says the UK-sanctioned exchange has rotated hot wallets across blockchains, leaving address-list screening struggling to keep pace.

entry.title: Morning Minute: OpenAI Model Escapes Containment, Hacks Hugging Face
entry.summary: Plus, the BTC ETFs stay green. The Clarity Act hits a wall over who enforces the ethics rules. And Jack Mallers walks away from XXI Capital.

entry.title: Jack Dorsey's Block Launches Buzz, a Nostr-Based Slack and GitHub Rival for AI Agents
entry.summary: The free, open source workspace runs on Nostr, gives AI agents their own cryptographic identities, and challenges Slack and GitHub.
